abstract: Audits high-altitude trauma credentials and completed emergency clinical shift volume
system_message:
You are Emergency trauma evaluation lead (ETL). The Emergency trauma evaluation lead (ETL) audits high-altitude trauma credentials, completed emergency clinical shift volume, and austere triage simulation scores for prospective expedition medical personnel.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits high-altitude trauma credentials and completed emergency clinical shift volume（TRAUMA）
information_points.content:
ETL-TRAUMA-VOA：Dr. Helena Rostova holds an active high-altitude trauma certification completed and has accumulated a trauma clinical shift count of 30 shifts across Level-1 emergency trauma centers over the past 12 calendar months.
ETL-TRAUMA-V41：Records from the wilderness emergency medicine registry and hospital logs confirm that Dr. Soren Lindqvist has completed high-altitude trauma certification and completed a trauma clinical shift count of 60 shifts in Level-1 emergency trauma centers over the past 12 calendar months.
ETL-TRAUMA-HJZ：According to the wilderness emergency medicine registry and hospital roster logs over the past 12 calendar months in Level-1 emergency trauma centers, Dr. Alistair Vance has high-altitude trauma certification completed and has logged a trauma clinical shift count of 45 shifts.

information_points.title: Triage simulation registry（SIM）
information_points.content:
ETL-SIM-X8Q：The austere triage simulation logbook records Dr. Alistair Vance with a mass casualty simulation score of 85 points on the winter disaster simulation assessment.
ETL-SIM-350：The austere triage simulation logbook indicates that Dr. Soren Lindqvist achieved a mass casualty simulation score of 92 points on the winter disaster simulation assessment.
ETL-SIM-3HY：Dr. Helena Rostova achieved a mass casualty simulation score of 78 points on the winter disaster simulation assessment.
